title: Watch Me Edit: Building a Cinematic Documentary Opening
fulltitle: Watch Me Edit: Building a Cinematic Documentary Opening
description:
In this first episode of Watch Me Edit, Paddy Bird takes a documentary opening sequence that isn’t working and rebuilds it from the ground up.

You’ll see, in real time, how character introduction, dialogue choice, pacing, and music all work together to create a more cinematic and intriguing opening.

This isn’t about software tricks or shortcuts — it’s about slowing down, layering information, and pulling the audience into the story without giving everything away too soon.
